items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I met Jelly Roll up here at the theatre, you know?

ctx.x: Who did you meet? Who was the first piano player you met around here? Did you know anything about Jelly Roll?
Oh, Jelly Roll -- I was trying to think about that; I met Jelly Roll up here at the theatre, you know?
He used to pace around in front of the Lafayette Theatre, and Jelly Roll Morton -- so I'll come up to that later.

items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Jelly Roll Morton, I used to meet him in front of the Lafayette Theatre, had his music under his arm, walking up and down, said he was going to make it one day.

ctx.x: Willie Smith. Tell me about some of these other piano players, some of these guys. What about --
Jelly Roll Morton, I used to meet him in front of the Lafayette Theatre, had his music under his arm, walking up and down, said he was going to make it one day. Jelly Roll Morton.
What kind of dude was he.
